items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we really do need her name. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Her name?

ctx.x: Alright, so that was your first marriage and your only child and of course we know about your marriage to Marian and the happy statistics on that. But we have to work backwards a little bit. You mentioned your mother coming from Scotland but we really do need her name. (LAUGHTER).
Yes and your father's name and where he's from.
